title: PLAYER 2'S CROWBAR AND BLASTS ACT LIKE THE HOST'S
why: When player 2 hit a pillager with the crowbar, a frag charge, a finisher or an air strike, the host rolled the pillager out of the line as if it were a gun round. The host own blows never do that. Now only a gun round of player 2 (the word carrying sk) rolls him; damage and the kill credit are unchanged.
now: Player 2s crowbar, frag charges and air strikes hit a pillager the same way the hosts do.
